payload.summary: Bounded discovery for CHANGE-20260928T191100Z-226f0cf0: src/greeting.mjs exports only greet; both validators (scripts/validate.mjs, scripts/contract.mjs) already assert FAREWELL === "bye", so validation is currently RED and adding `export const FAREWELL = "bye"` is exactly what turns it green. contract.mjs additionally whitelists greeting.mjs public exports to {greet, FAREWELL}, so the re-exporting usage module must be a new separate .mjs file (none exists yet; no validator references one). Static-only verification: controller permissions deny bash, so validators were not executed.

relevantFiles.reason: Sole source module; currently exports only greet (L1-3). Target for new FAREWELL constant export; validators require FAREWELL === "bye" and whitelist public exports to exactly greet+FAREWELL.
npm test entry (fixture-greeting). L7 asserts module.FAREWELL !== "bye" -> currently pushes failure; defines the green-bar condition for the change.
contract-test validator. L8-9 require FAREWELL to be a string equal "bye"; L11 rejects any greeting.mjs export outside [greet, FAREWELL] — constrains how the change may be wired.
Defines the single test entry: node scripts/validate.mjs; no type field, so new modules must be .mjs ESM.
Declares both required validation commands (node scripts/validate.mjs, node scripts/contract.mjs) and baseRef master — the deterministic gate the change must keep green.

evidence: src/greeting.mjs contains only `export function greet(name)` returning `Hello, ${name}!` (symbol greet, L1-3); no FAREWELL symbol exists (symbols overview: Function:[greet]).

scripts/validate.mjs:7 `if (!failures.length && module.FAREWELL !== "bye") failures.push("FAREWELL export")` — greet check passes (greet("AEH")==="Hello, AEH!") and module import succeeds, so undefined FAREWELL uniquely yields exit 1 / VALIDATION_FAILED.
scripts/contract.mjs:8-9 require typeof FAREWELL === "string" and FAREWELL === "bye" — same failure path (reported via the L10 .then callback as CONTRACT_FAILED).
grep across *.mjs: only export statement in src/ is `export function greet` (src/greeting.mjs:1).
findings.notes: Validation is currently RED, not green; the change is both additive (FAREWELL export) and a repair of the existing deterministic gate.

evidence: scripts/contract.mjs:11 `if (Object.keys(moduleValue).some((key) => !["greet", "FAREWELL"].includes(key))) failures.push("unexpected public export")` on import("../src/greeting.mjs").
No other src/ files exist (glob src/** -> only src/greeting.mjs).
findings.notes: Any extra export added to greeting.mjs breaks contract-test. The usage/re-export module must live in its own file, not as additional greeting.mjs exports.

evidence: glob src/**/*,specs/**,tests/**,test/** -> only src/greeting.mjs.
grep for re-export/import patterns: only scripts/validate.mjs:1,6 and scripts/contract.mjs:1,7,10 import ../src/greeting.mjs; no file imports or is imported as a usage module.
grep 'usage' across repo matched only .serena/project.yml documentation URLs.
findings.notes: The usage module is greenfield: name/path are unconstrained by existing validators (nothing imports it), so any src/*.mjs re-exporting FAREWELL satisfies the request as written.

evidence: bash tool denied by controller permission rules (permission bash * -> deny), so `node scripts/validate.mjs`, `node scripts/contract.mjs` and `npm test` could not be executed.
